name: Chiyoda Momoka
source: Daughter of a rich family with a weak body. She's [url=/c22754]Sena's[/url] childhood friend who created the drama club along with her maid, [url=/c22758]Maria[/url]. She has loved [url=/c22753]Mayu's[/url] acting ever since she was young and has always wished to perform together with her. Momoka's voice is often complimented to be very beautiful and she is able to speak English fluently.
